name: EDELWEISS
full_name: Expérience pour DEtecter Les WIMPs En Site Souterrain
summary: EDELWEISS searches for dark matter with cryogenic germanium detectors at Modane, France. Its technology has extended from higher-mass WIMP searches to sub-GeV and electron-recoil channels.
detection_principle: Heat and ionization are measured in germanium, with electrode geometry rejecting surface events. High-voltage low-threshold devices amplify phonons from drifting charge to detect very few electron–hole pairs.

results.summary: Germanium-target limits were published on sub-MeV dark-matter–electron interactions.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
